_reasoningEffortOptions: "low" | "high" | "max" (default "high") on thinking-capable models (deepseek-reasoner/deepseek-flash). Thinking mode must be enabled (thinking.type: "enabled", the default) - other user-facing inputs get coerced to the nearest of the three supported levels rather than erroring.
nudgeMessage: Submit your complete response ONLY by calling the submit_response function with all required fields populated. Do not output JSON in text.
_agentToolChoiceMode: thinking mode rejects tool_choice "required" with HTTP 400 ("Thinking mode does not support this tool_choice") - "auto" relies on the agent loop's plain-text-final-answer resubmit nudge instead.
